method: Independent direct HTTP status, redirect, media-type and content-hash checks plus page-level extraction from the Repsol half-year report and European Commission decision; Stonepeak, Chinese competition authority, Texas Comptroller, Hecate and live-portfolio inspection; closing and exit search

verifiedClaims: Repsol completed the transfer after satisfying the agreement conditions in February 2026
Stonepeak acquired 43.8% of the 629 MW Outpost solar project for $253 million
The report distinguishes the completed Outpost sale from later signed but unclosed transactions
Stonepeak agreed to buy 43.8% for $252.5 million
Outpost is a 629 MW Webb County, Texas solar project that began commercial operation in August 2025 and has a long-term PPA
The transaction was initially subject to regulatory approvals
The European Commission cleared the transaction January 15, 2026
Stonepeak and Repsol Renewables would acquire joint control of Outpost Solar SellCo LLC by share purchase
The target JV owns and operates the Outpost Project in Webb County, Texas
The Chinese competition-authority list records unconditional approval on January 5, 2026
The row identifies Stonepeak's acquisition of an equity interest in Outpost Solar SellCo LLC and Repsol Renewables as the counterparty
The Texas project record identifies Hecate Energy Outpost Solar LLC and its United ISD agreement history
The developer/project SPV is an underlying legal entity rather than evidence of a separate current manager-level platform
Hecate's live project page does not present Outpost as a current Hecate-owned platform
The page is contextual developer-origin evidence and not current ownership evidence
Stonepeak's live portfolio page does not list Outpost by name
The page separately describes the July 2025 Frye and Jicarilla portfolio, so that holding is not merged into Outpost
The absent live card does not override Repsol's later direct closing evidence

exitSearch.result: The announced 43.8% Stonepeak acquisition closed in February 2026. No later cancellation, equity transfer, Stonepeak exit, Repsol exit or signed pending sale was found. The live Stonepeak portfolio page's separate Frye/Jicarilla holding is not Outpost and does not change the Outpost boundary.

responseSourceHealthCorrections: Repsol's report is the legal-closing source; the December 2025 Stonepeak announcement remains announcement and operating-context evidence only.

Repsol's 56.2% retained share is an arithmetic inference from prior sole control plus the disclosed 43.8% transfer and joint-control evidence; it is not a separately stated cap-table percentage and must remain labeled as derived.
Hecate's live projects page no longer names Outpost and is not treated as current ownership evidence.
Stonepeak's live portfolio page names the separate Frye/Jicarilla portfolio but not Outpost; the absence does not negate Repsol's subsequent first-party closing report.
